capabilities.rationale: The sandboxed browser runtime allows autonomous agents to safely access and extract live web documentation without exposing the trusted control plane or host operating system to malicious payloads, drive-by downloads, or SSRF attacks.

Celesto pre-execution safety callbacks intercept every command before guest dispatch, enforcing deterministic deny rules against filesystem destruction and secret exfiltration rather than relying solely on probabilistic model prompts.

Strict network boundary policies restrict outbound egress to permitted public research domains and documentation endpoints, preventing agent lateral movement or unauthorized command-and-control communication.
